transcript.text: Our Samsung combi microwave keeps whirring for a few minutes after it's finished and beeped, even with the door open. Old one never did that. Is the fan stuck on?

Probably not. A combi microwave commonly keeps its cooling fan running after the programme has beeped, and it can continue with the door open; it is cooling the magnetron and, after combi/grill use, the hot internal parts. Different models do this for different lengths of time, so the old one is not a reliable comparison. It is more concerning if it runs indefinitely, starts while the oven has been idle, becomes unusually loud, or there is a hot/burning smell—then the fan control may not be switching off and it needs a microwave engineer rather than internal DIY work.

candidates: Cooling fan/control relay not switching off (low)

reading.symptom: keeps whirring for a few minutes after finishing, even with the door open

plan: They asked: "Is the fan stuck on?" - answer that first.
Already given by the customer, never ask for it again: make Samsung.
The fault they reported is: "keeps whirring for a few minutes after finishing, even with the door open". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
